command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$workspace = (Get-Location).Path
& "$workspace\.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Verify-Ledger.ps1" -WorkspaceRoot $workspace
$jsonPaths = @(
  '.forge-codex/state/run-state.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/evidence/P14/authoritative-mcp-runtime-persistence-checkpoint.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/commands/20260827T051638910Z-d90c38e6.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/commands/20260827T051933035Z-a5353193.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/commands/20260827T052009026Z-5792fdf6.json'
)
foreach ($relative in $jsonPaths) {
  $null = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $workspace $relative) | ConvertFrom-Json
}
& "$workspace\.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Validate-NoAttribution.ps1" -WorkspaceRoot $workspace
& "$workspace\.forge-codex\instructions\scripts\Validate-NoPython.ps1" -WorkspaceRoot $workspace
& git diff --check
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "git diff --check failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }
$textPaths = @(
  '.forge-codex/state/event-ledger.jsonl',
  '.forge-codex/state/run-state.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/decisions/P14-005-authoritative-mcp-runtime-persistence.md',
  '.forge-codex/state/evidence/P14/authoritative-mcp-runtime-persistence-checkpoint.json',
  'CMakeLists.txt',
  'include/ForgeConductor/Contracts/IForgeStatusRepository.h',
  'include/ForgeConductor/Domain/ForgeStatusModels.h',
  'include/ForgeConductor/Persistence/Windows/WindowsAuditRepository.h',
  'include/ForgeConductor/Persistence/Windows/WindowsForgeStatusRepository.h',
  'src/Domain/ForgeStatusModels.cpp',
  'src/Persistence/Windows/WindowsAuditRepository.cpp',
  'src/Persistence/Windows/WindowsForgeStatusRepository.cpp',
  'tests/Persistence/AuditRepositoryWindowsTests.cpp',
  'tests/Persistence/ForgeStatusRepositoryWindowsTests.cpp'
)
foreach ($relative in $textPaths) {
  $path = Join-Path $workspace $relative
  $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($path)
  if ($bytes.Length -ge 3 -and $bytes[0] -eq 0xef -and $bytes[1] -eq 0xbb -and $bytes[2] -eq 0xbf) {
    throw "$relative contains a UTF-8 BOM."
  }
  $text = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true).GetString($bytes)
  if ([regex]::IsMatch($text, '(?<!\r)\n|\r(?!\n)')) {
    throw "$relative contains a non-CRLF line ending."
  }
}
Write-Host "P14 checkpoint integrity validation passed."
